resources.string:
What's new in 2.0:
- Schedule: browse past and future weeks with new navigation controls — no more being stuck on the current week
- Objectives: players can now set their own goals; home screen stats now reflect your real progress
- Chat: players can start a conversation with their coach directly from the app
- Profile: edit your details through an updated profile screen
- Team accounts: home screen and progress view now show live roster and session data
- General accuracy and stability improvements
